name: podcast-metadata
description: Repair Apple podcast RSS and episode metadata from XML and host-form exports. Preserve episode GUIDs, find duplicate media URLs, and return corrected XML or a field change table. Separate host edits from Apple Podcasts Connect edits, episode sorting from availability, and Connect form limits from RSS host limits. Works from pasted text and supplied exports.
